# Test fixtures

`whois/*.txt` are raw WHOIS replies, as python-whois's client receives them.
All except `com_held.txt` were captured live on 2026-11-16 from whois.verisign-grs.com,
whois.tld.ee and whois.eurid.eu.

`com_held.txt` is `com_registered.txt` edited by hand to carry clientHold and redemptionPeriod.
